question: Who introduced the Anusandhan National Research Foundation Bill, 2023, in the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Jitender Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Jitender Singh** introduced the Anusandhan National Research Foundation Bill, 2023, in the Lok Sabha.
 
• The bill aims to establish the Anusandhan National Research Foundation to promote and fund research across various fields in India.
 
• This initiative is part of the government's effort to boost scientific research and innovation in the country.
 
• The foundation will play a crucial role in enhancing the research infrastructure and capabilities of Indian institutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Anusandhan National Research Foundation** will focus on collaborative research involving academia, industry, and government agencies.
 
• It aims to address key national challenges and drive technological advancements.
 
• The foundation will also facilitate international collaborations and partnerships in research and development.
 
• Through this bill, the government intends to create a robust ecosystem for research and innovation, contributing to India's growth and development.
